subject.title: perf: avoid event-loop stall during embedded_run bootstrap-context

question: Should maintainers accept PR #89040's focused loader/liveness proof and custom glob-walker compatibility risk as sufficient to land the #87509 mitigation?
rationale: The code path and tests support the fix, but only maintainers can decide whether focused proof is enough for a P1 availability/message-loss issue that changes bootstrap-file matching internals.

options.title: Accept focused proof and land after fresh gates
options.body: Treat the loader liveness proof plus parity tests as sufficient for this narrow mitigation, then require exact-head CI before merge.

options.title: Require full live embedded-run proof
options.body: Ask for a real channel or Gateway embedded_run run showing keepalives remain responsive before accepting the availability risk.

options.title: Pause for broader architecture
options.body: Keep this PR open or close it in favor of worker isolation and priority scheduling work under the broader event-loop architecture issue.

recommendation.title: Accept focused proof and land after fresh gates
recommendation.body: Treat the loader liveness proof plus parity tests as sufficient for this narrow mitigation, then require exact-head CI before merge.
